annotations.title: Explain an Iranian legal term (واژه‌نامهٔ حقوقی)

description: Explain what a Persian legal term means — «مهرالمثل», «اعسار», «قیم», «سرقفلی» — from Dadras's legal glossary: up to three distinct definitions, each with the article it explains and that article's dadrasai.com link. Use it when the question is what a legal word means; for the rules that apply to it, use search_iranian_law. When the whole phrase has no entry, its most specific word is looked up and the result names the word defined. The definitions are Dadras's explanatory notes, not statutory text.

term.description: The term in Persian, one or two words, e.g. «مهرالمثل» or «خیار غبن».

name: explain_legal_term

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.
